oneLiner: 导电性介于导体与绝缘体之间，掺入杂质可精确调控，是晶体管的基石。
oneLinerEn: Conductivity between conductor and insulator, tunable by doping — the basis of transistors.
detail: PN 结具有单向导电性，是二极管、晶体管、集成电路的基础；硅晶片上数十亿晶体管构成现代计算机与手机的核心。
detailEn: A PN junction conducts one way, forming diodes, transistors and ICs; billions of transistors on silicon wafers power computers and phones.

oneLiner: 某些材料降到临界温度以下电阻突降为零并完全抗磁。
oneLinerEn: Below a critical temperature some materials drop to zero resistance and expel magnetic fields.
detail: 零电阻可实现无损耗输电、强磁体（磁悬浮、MRI）；迈斯纳效应体现完全抗磁性；高温超导仍在攻关。
detailEn: Zero resistance enables lossless power and strong magnets (maglev, MRI); the Meissner effect shows full diamagnetism; high-Tc remains a goal.

oneLiner: 受激辐射放大产生方向性好、单色度高、亮度极强的人造光。
oneLinerEn: Light amplified by stimulated emission — highly directional, monochromatic and intense.
detail: 激光用于光纤通信、精密切割、激光雷达、眼科手术与条码扫描；其相干性与高亮度源于受激辐射。
detailEn: Used in fiber optics, cutting, LIDAR, eye surgery and scanning; coherence and brightness come from stimulated emission.

oneLiner: 核裂变与核聚变释放巨大能量，是重要的高效能源。
oneLinerEn: Fission and fusion release vast energy — potent power sources.
detail: 核电站用可控裂变链式反应发电；太阳与氢弹靠聚变；可控聚变（“人造太阳”）因清洁、原料丰富而被寄予厚望。
detailEn: Reactors run controlled fission; the Sun and bombs use fusion; controlled fusion (artificial suns) is prized for clean, abundant fuel.

oneLiner: 无线电波到射线构成电磁波谱，不同波段各有应用。
oneLinerEn: From radio to gamma rays, each band has its uses.
detail: 无线电用于通信广播，微波用于雷达与加热，红外线遥感与热成像，可见光是视觉，紫外线杀菌，X 射线成像，γ 射线治疗与探伤。
detailEn: Radio for comms, microwaves for radar/heating, infrared for remote sensing, visible for sight, UV for sterilizing, X-rays for imaging, gamma for therapy/inspection.

oneLiner: 让光在玻璃纤维中全反射长途奔流，承载现代互联网的信息洪流。
oneLinerEn: Light races by total internal reflection through glass fibers, carrying the flood of modern internet data.
detail: 利用光的全反射把信号锁在纤芯内几乎无损地传输，一条光纤可同时传送海量通话与网络数据，构成全球通信的骨干。
detailEn: Total internal reflection traps the signal in the core with little loss; one fiber carries vast simultaneous voice and data traffic—the backbone of global communication.

oneLiner: 用强磁场与无线电波让人体内的氢原子发出信号，绘制无损的软组织图像。
oneLinerEn: Strong fields and radio waves make body hydrogen emit signals, painting soft-tissue images without radiation.
detail: 氢核在磁场中按特定频率共振，撤去脉冲后回波被接收并重建为断层图像；因不含电离辐射，特别适合观察脑与关节等软组织。
detailEn: Hydrogen nuclei resonate at a set frequency in the field; after pulses their echoes are received and rebuilt into slices—free of ionizing radiation, ideal for brain and joints.

oneLiner: 用电磁场把微观粒子加速到近光速并对撞，揭示物质最深处的结构。
oneLinerEn: Electric and magnetic fields drive particles near light speed and smash them, probing matter's innermost structure.
detail: 大型强子对撞机等环形加速器将质子加速对撞，从碰撞碎片中寻找希格斯玻色子等粒子，是研究基本相互作用的前沿工具。
detailEn: Ring machines like the Large Hadron Collider speed protons into collisions, seeking particles such as the Higgs boson among the debris—a frontier tool for the fundamental forces.

oneLiner: 利用量子叠加与纠缠并行探索答案，在特定问题上远超经典计算机。
oneLinerEn: Exploiting superposition and entanglement to explore answers in parallel, far outpacing classical machines on select problems.
detail: 量子比特可同时处于零与一的叠加，多比特纠缠令状态空间指数膨胀，在因数分解、模拟分子等任务上潜力巨大，但离通用普及尚远。
detailEn: A qubit holds a blend of zero and one at once, and entangling many grows the state space exponentially—huge promise for factoring and simulating molecules, yet far from general use.
